profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, and trades under the ticker APPN. According to its website, it sells AI automation for critical business processes, and describes its platform as orchestrating AI agents, systems, and people without replacing a customer's existing systems. The company says it has been automating processes for more than 25 years and that its customers build AI-powered processes intended to accelerate work, reduce cost, and manage risk.

The site lists uses across finance and operations, including accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and contract management, purchase-to-pay, audit and compliance workflows, case management, onboarding, order management, and contract review. It also advertises low-code app building with embedded AI agents that can extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Appian states that onboarding time can be cut by up to 50 percent, that it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI value study produced with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

Company records show it registered with the SEC under CIK 0001441683. Its recorded legal exposure is in Virginia, with 152 entries. No litigation cases, MCP servers, or individual products are catalogued for it.
